decisionGroups.rationale: The current target already includes justified rational term transformations (2c4830), systematic linear equations with substitution checks (325771), and ratio equations with domain and original checks (671ef). The cited primary passages explicitly support simple linear/bracketed and ratio/fraction equations, or simple variable-denominator examples, together with reasoning, method choice or verification. The whole comparison is a bounded integration of these existing skills; it does not add advanced rational-function theory.
decisionGroups.officialClaimBoundary: SkillPilot-authored whole assessment using supported skills. No claim that the exact two equations, 20/15 rubric, every comparison detail or all description variants are individually prescribed by the official source.

decisionGroups.rationale: Bremen supports term expansion/factorisation, algebraic linear equations, checking results and explaining/evaluating solution paths. The concrete variable-denominator ratio comparison is not literally prescribed here. Because ratio solving including domain conditions is already target 671ef, this short comparison is a motivated additional SkillPilot integration, not a new topic family.
decisionGroups.officialClaimBoundary: Mark the own comparative exercise as an additional SkillPilot competence/form; do not claim that this exact denominator comparison is an official Bremen compulsory requirement.

decisionGroups.rationale: The primary source supports distributive/term structures, proportionality and quotient equality, strategy choice and equivalent equation transformations. The exact ratio-equation comparison is a bounded own integration of the already targeted 671ef, 325771 and 2c4830 competencies. The current fa0 applicability explicitly lacks DE-SH: this omission must be changed transparently if implementing the eight reviewed SH pairs; it is not already an active permission.
decisionGroups.officialClaimBoundary: Explicit own additional exercise, no fabricated official full-coverage source mapping. A jurisdiction applicability addition alone must not activate unreviewed SekII-only or other scopes.

decisionGroups.rationale: The canonical ALL/SekI target already has all three underlying competencies. The same bounded comparison is a suitable canonical integration. ALL is a SkillPilot composition and is not an official nationwide syllabus.

Exponential graphs, growth, half/doubling time and interpretation are explicit in 3.3.4. General modelling requires assumptions, interpretation, validity checks and critical prognosis. Constructing two simple models, graphs, a joined changed-factor continuation and a concrete limitation is appropriate at the existing J10 target, with no differential equation or logarithmic inversion required.
decisionGroups.officialClaimBoundary: Own assessment combining content and process competencies, not literal official prescription of the four subtasks.

decisionGroups.rationale: The source explicitly pairs contextual growth and decay, exponential terms and graphs with interpreting/checking model results. The small assumption change remains within this known function family. Treating finite positive decay separately from a real detection threshold is an appropriate contextual check.
decisionGroups.officialClaimBoundary: Own bounded modelling assessment, not a claim that every variation or parameter case is mandatory.

decisionGroups.rationale: The 2022 annex replaces the binding year-9 content/standards with linear and quadratic functions, while its points 1 and 3 retain the former activity overview and process competencies, which still mention exponential models and model variation. Therefore neither an explicit universal compulsory exponential-content claim nor a complete ban follows. The existing SkillPilot target 42e19186 already contains growth AND decay with terms, tables, graphs and context; the whole form is a motivated bounded extension of that target with model evaluation, not an arbitrary new family.
decisionGroups.officialClaimBoundary: Record as SkillPilot additional modelling and preserve the annex qualification. Do not call exponentials or logarithms universally compulsory in Bremen from the old 2006 content pages.

decisionGroups.rationale: All 44 candidates are GK with first-order solving 28c as the unserved target, and no targeted DGL2 goal. The complete exam is about second order, restoring acceleration, two derivatives of trigonometric candidates, periods and oscillator behaviour. This is meaningful LK content, but adding it solely to demand a DGL1 predecessor introduces unnecessary new content. Existing R-context presence proves neither scope fit nor didactic need. The Hessian source explicitly distinguishes the first-order GK/LK section from second-order LK; no universal claim about prohibitions in the other states is needed for this rejection.
decisionGroups.officialClaimBoundary: Existing 88 target placements and the content correctness of the LK form are not revoked or newly certified. Only the proposed 44 new GK placements are rejected.
